message.content: **Summary:** I reviewed the saved notes (long-term holder, dividends reinvested manually) and the account (75,000 USD cash, 50 HD shares, no AMZN position), then checked the AMZN quote at 195.25 (bid 195.23 / ask 195.27). AMZN is within the mandate's permitted tickers, and the fundamentals from the FY2023 10-K (filed 2024-02-02) support adding a long-term position: revenue of $574,785M, operating income of $36,852M, net income of $30,425M, diluted EPS of $2.90, and operating cash flow of $84,946M — a business with strong cash generation and improving profitability. I placed a single buy limit order for 25 shares at $195.30, just above the ask so it would execute near market, for a notional of about $4,882.50 — under the $5,000 per-order cap and well within the $10,000 daily total, with no money moved out of the account. The order filled at $195.30.
